To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
mobile devices are not only used for different purposes but also have a different impact on the network.

1) YouTube traffic from smartphones and tablets is more bursty than traffic generated from PCs, 2) the video bitrate is lower in smartphones and tablets than in PCs and 3) the video bitrate in smartphones and tablets is lower than that of the PC when the same video content is requested.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the impact that the device, the network infrastructure and the application have on the user experience.
understanding the impact of the user's device and network infrastructure on the user's experience of YouTube.
the following aspects: • We study the impact of device and network infrastructure on YouTube user experience, in terms of video start-up time and video quality.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mobile devices generate less traffic, but the traffic they generate is much more demanding in terms of the infrastructure and the application performance.
the mobile users are not as demanding as the users with PCs and that the mobile users do not suffer from a worse experience.
mobile YouTube users experience a much worse video quality than desktop users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mobile devices are not only a new source of traffic for YouTube, but they are also changing the way users access YouTube and consume video content.
mobile devices have a significant impact on YouTube traffic and user experience, but the impact is not the same for different mobile devices.
mobile devices are not just smaller versions of PCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mobile users are less sensitive to the network conditions and are willing to accept a lower quality experience than the desktop users.
the YouTube user experience on mobile devices is significantly different from that on PCs.
mobile devices have a different behavior from desktop devices and that the user experience is affected by the device and the network infrastructure.
